title: Malicious code in array-flatten-utils (npm)
description: The npm package 'array-flatten-utils' masquerades as a simple array utility but contains malicious native addons and a large obfuscated payload. It loads platform-specific native modules that decode and execute a hidden JavaScript payload, dropping and running files stealthily. Execution is triggered only in CI/build environments and avoids detection by common analysis tools and debuggers. This behavior indicates a staged loader designed to compromise CI environments where sensitive credentials and tokens are present.
